items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: And it mentions Harold Lee on drums. And "Leonard Davidson worked with Clay frequently..."

ctx.x: Well, I never know him to play saxophone. He played, I think, marimba and piano and...and, let's see, what else Sonny played? I think he played drum...I think he played drums in my brother's orchestra. I think he was a drummer when he first come here from Tucson.
And it mentions Harold Lee on drums. And "Leonard Davidson worked with Clay frequently..."
Yeah, yeah, Davidson worked for me. He's a big fella...saxophone player. We call him "Big Boy." 'at's all.
